```{r}
# ===== EXPERIMENT CONFIG =====
# >>> CHANGE THESE when switching to precip + categorical land cover
data_version <- "v1_1h_lcdist"
input_file   <- here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha_1h.rds")

hab_terms <- c("fence_dist", "road_dist", "water_rivers_dist", "cropland_dist",
               "grassland_dist", "shrubland_dist", "tree_cover_dist", "urban_dist",
               "elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop")
mov_terms <- character(0)

# extraction functions that match how input_file was built (for the 6h/12h tests)
extract_lc_fun <- readRDS(here("outputs", "extract_lc_dist.rds"))
# later: extract_lc_fun <- extract_lc_mixed   (after source()-ing ssf_functions.R)
# ==============================

exp_dir <- here("outputs", "experiments_etosha", data_version)
dir.create(exp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
base_rhs <- paste(c(hab_terms, mov_terms), collapse = " + ")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
#chunk 1: load all data
ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(input_file)
cat("rows:", nrow(ele_trk_extract_etosha), "\n")

# checkpoint: every model term exists in the data
setdiff(c(hab_terms, mov_terms), names(ele_trk_extract_etosha))   # should be character(0)

complete_data <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  mutate(step_id_ = if (any(grepl("_", step_id_))) step_id_ else paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_")) |>
  grep("hydro_year", readLines(here("code", "etosha_yearly_ssf.Rmd")), value = TRUE) |>
  drop_na(all_of(c(hab_terms, mov_terms)))

cat("complete rows:", nrow(complete_data), "\n")
complete_data |> count(hydro_year, season)

sandbox <- complete_data |> filter(hydro_year == 2015, season == "dry")
cat("sandbox:", n_distinct(sandbox$id), "elephants,", n_distinct(sandbox$step_id_), "strata\n")
```
